args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Based on the vacation itinerary for Hawaii (June 10-20, 2024), here are the essential items to pack:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and general sightseeing)
- Camera (to capture memories at all locations)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, hotel reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel (for Waikiki Beach and North Shore)
- Snorkeling gear (optional - can rent at Hanauma Bay)
- Hiking shoes/boots (for Diamond Head trail)
- Comfortable walking shoes (for Pearl Harbor and shopping)
- Light rain jacket (just in case)
- Luau attire (for Polynesian Cultural Center event)
- Waterproof phone case (for water activities)

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses
- Hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Portable charger
- Reusable water bottle
